name: Asahina Mikuru
source:
Age: Unknown (18 Speculated Only)
Occupation: Time Traveler, Student at grade 11-12

Asahina Mikuru is the fourth member to join the SOS Brigade, and the only person other than [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] to join against her will. She is a shy and cute "moe" girl, often harassed by [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url]. She is secretly a time traveler from the future who came back in time to observe Her. She is best friends with [url=/c71237]Tsuruya[/url] and shows a great talent for brewing tea. She often has trouble talking to [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] because many of the things he asks about are "classified" She is the mascot for the SOS Brigade, mainly as a way to attract attention. Because she is so popular, [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url] uses her as eye candy. 

[Edited From [url=http://haruhi.wikia.com/wiki/Mikuru_Asahina]Suzumiya Haruhi Wiki[/url]]
